name: PKR inhibitor
summary: C16 (PKRi, GW 506033X) is a drug which acts as a selective inhibitor of the enzyme double-stranded RNA-dependent protein kinase (PKR). It has been shown to effectively inhibit PKR function in vivo and has neuroprotective and nootropic effects in animal studies. C16 has anti-viral activity, in A549 cells, against hemorrhagic viruses of mammarenaviruses such as lassa and junin.

pharmacology.text: C16 (PKRi, GW 506033X) is a drug which acts as a selective inhibitor of the enzyme double-stranded RNA-dependent protein kinase (PKR).

summaryZh: C16（也稱為PKRi或GW 506033X）是一種蛋白激酶R（PKR，也稱為雙鏈RNA依賴性蛋白激酶）的選擇性酶抑制劑。
summaryZhHans: C16（也称为PKRi或GW 506033X）是一种蛋白激酶R（PKR，也称为双链RNA依赖性蛋白激酶）的选择性酶抑制剂。

uses.en: It is a research chemical used in laboratory and animal studies of memory, inflammation and brain cell damage. It is not an approved medicine.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化學品，用於記憶、發炎和腦細胞損傷的實驗室與動物研究，並不是核准的藥物。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化学品，用于记忆、发炎和脑细胞损伤的实验室与动物研究，并不是核准的药物。

fact.en: The enzyme C16 blocks, PKR, is part of the body's defence against viruses: when it senses double-stranded RNA it shuts down protein production in the cell.
fact.zh: C16 所抑制的酵素 PKR 是人體抵抗病毒的機制之一：當它偵測到雙股 RNA 時，會關閉細胞內的蛋白質合成。
fact.zhHans: C16 所抑制的酵素 PKR 是人体抵抗病毒的机制之一：当它侦测到双股 RNA 时，会关闭细胞内的蛋白质合成。
